Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.vaultmesh

Class KfeVaultMeshTlsSupport

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.integration.vaultmesh.KfeVaultMeshTlsSupport
public final class KfeVaultMeshTlsSupport extends Object
Optional mTLS materials for KfeVaultMeshSettlementClient. Supports PKCS12 keystore/truststore paths or PEM cert/key/CA paths (kfe.vaultmesh.tls.*).

  • Method Details

    • buildSslContext

      public static SSLContext buildSslContext(String certPath, String keyPath, String caPath, String keystorePath, String keystorePassword, String keystoreType, String truststorePath, String truststorePassword, String truststoreType)
      Builds a TLS context from a complete keystore/truststore pair when supplied, otherwise from PEM certificate/key/CA files. Client identity and server trust remain separate JSSE roles.
      Parameters:
      certPath - PEM client certificate or chain path
      keyPath - PEM or DER RSA private-key path
      caPath - PEM CA bundle trusted for the server
      keystorePath - optional client keystore path
      keystorePassword - client keystore password
      keystoreType - client keystore format, usually PKCS12
      truststorePath - optional truststore path
      truststorePassword - truststore password
      truststoreType - truststore format, usually PKCS12
      Returns:
      initialized TLS context with client key managers and remote trust managers
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when files, key material, providers, or TLS initialization fail

    • requestFactory

      public static org.springframework.http.client.SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory requestFactory(SSLContext sslContext, boolean hostnameVerification, int connectTimeoutMs, int readTimeoutMs, Proxy proxy)
      Creates an HTTP request factory that installs the supplied SSL context on HTTPS connections, applies hostname verification policy and timeouts, and optionally routes through a proxy.
      Parameters:
      sslContext - TLS context providing client keys and trusted server certificates
      hostnameVerification - whether the default HTTPS hostname verifier is retained
      connectTimeoutMs - connection timeout in milliseconds
      readTimeoutMs - response-read timeout in milliseconds
      proxy - optional explicit HTTP/SOCKS proxy
      Returns:
      configured request factory for Spring's RestTemplate

    • validateTransport

      public static Proxy validateTransport(String transport, String socksHost, int socksPort, boolean tlsEnabled, Collection<String> vaultUrls)
      Validates direct/Tor mode and returns a resolved SOCKS proxy for Tor. Tor requires mTLS, a valid SOCKS address/port, and exclusively HTTPS onion destinations; destination DNS remains delegated to SOCKS instead of being resolved by this process.
      Parameters:
      transport - configured mode, either direct or tor; null defaults to direct
      socksHost - SOCKS proxy host for Tor mode
      socksPort - SOCKS proxy port for Tor mode
      tlsEnabled - whether mutual TLS is enabled
      vaultUrls - configured Vault destination URLs
      Returns:
      null for direct transport, or resolved SOCKS proxy for Tor
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - for unsupported mode, missing mTLS/proxy, invalid URL, or DNS failure
